title: The related companies California nursing homes pay the most
question: Which companies under common ownership with nursing homes receive the most from them, from how many homes, and since when?
finding: California nursing homes named 1191 distinct related companies (names as each home spelled them, lightly cleaned). The largest in 2025 is PACS (management, home office and administration): $166.2 million from 136 homes. 16 of them were paid by San Francisco homes in at least one year, led by PACS ($166.2 million statewide in 2025), Aspen Healthcare Services, LLC ($34.8 million statewide in 2025), Theragen ($27.8 million statewide in 2025). A further $19.4 million in 2025 went to parties whose names may be people's and are not shown.
how: Page 10.4 (lines 30 to 99) of every California skilled-nursing report, and page 3.1 for 2019, grouped by the related party's name after removing punctuation and endings such as LLC or Inc. The same company spelled two ways appears twice; two different companies with the same name would be merged.
limits: A name is all the file gives: it does not say who owns the related company, and similar names (a property company and an operating company of one group) are kept apart. Large totals belong to large chains and are expected; the screen shows where the money goes, not whether it was too much.
